It remains a mystery why Brian Wells insisted to police on the day of his death that three black men had strapped the bomb to him and forced him to rob the bank.
为什么布赖恩·韦尔斯在死的那天坚持向警方声称有三个黑人男子把炸弹绑在他身上并强迫他抢劫银行，这仍然是一个谜。
